rows.label: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate Key
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 1 Mutalist Alad V Nav Coordinate, 6 Nav Coordinate, 2,500 Nano Spores, 750 Ferrite

conditions: Queue one key per run if you are farming alone.
He is invulnerable while the collar is on. Apply Heat, Slash, or Toxin status during that phase; the procs persist and hit together when the collar comes off.
Bring a Specter or squadmate so he has a mind-control target and the vulnerable window lasts longer.
His Toxin bypasses shields. Use health, overguard, or damage reduction rather than a shield-tank.
Keep Magnetic status on him to limit shield regeneration between vulnerable phases.
bonuses: A high-fire-rate, high-status Heat weapon can end each damage window immediately. Bring two weapons so ammo does not stall the fight.

disclosures.title: the usual solo-fight mistake
disclosures.body: Direct damage only during a brief collar-off window makes this encounter feel impossibly slow. Stack status while he is immune, then let it resolve as the collar comes off.

disclosures.title: skip the fight: Circuit week 7
disclosures.body: With The Duviri Paradox done, pick Mesa in week 7 of the 11-week normal Circuit rotation. Tier 2 gives Neuroptics, tier 5 Chassis, tier 8 Systems and tier 10 the main blueprint, all guaranteed in one week. That skips the Market purchase, the Patient Zero key and every key craft.
